statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains low while closed-market weekend uncertainty keeps Stress extreme.

headline: Low Tail, extreme weekend Stress; Sunday reopening remains the key conditional risk window
body: NQ is closed. Friday's hawkish rates repricing, unresolved Hormuz restrictions and global FX-policy concerns keep reopening uncertainty elevated. Shared Finviz context is stale and excluded from supporting evidence; live NQ persistence remains unavailable.

lookbackSummary: From August 29 07:00 UTC through August 30 06:00 UTC, Tail stayed at 19% and dominant mode stayed normal while NQ was closed. Stress rose from 75% to 80%; confidence eased from 96% to 94%.
outlookSummary: Tail remains low through the closed Sunday hours while Stress first eases, then rebuilds into the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening. The opening hours are conditional WATCH; orderly two-sided price discovery would favor rapid de-escalation.
